login.title: Welcome Back
login.description: Sign in to your {{appName}} self-hosted account
login.footer: Enter your credentials to access the workspace
login.requestAccountHint: No account? Ask your workspace administrator to create one.

errors.ssoRequired: This account signs in through SSO. Use the SSO button below.
errors.ssoReauthRequired: Your SSO sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.

join.title: Join the workspace
join.description: Set your username and password to accept the invitation

errors.missingToken: No invitation token found in the link
errors.shortUsername: Username must be at least {{min}} characters
errors.shortPassword: Password must be at least {{min}} characters
errors.ssoRequiredForNewAccounts: New team accounts are created through SSO. Ask the owner to grant you access there, then sign in with SSO.

forceChangePassword.title: Set a new password
forceChangePassword.description: Your password was reset by an administrator. Choose a new password to continue.
forceChangePassword.footer: You must change your password before continuing

placeholders.currentPassword: Enter the temporary password you were given

errors.shortPassword: Password must be at least {{min}} characters

logout.title: Sign Out
logout.confirm: Are you sure you want to sign out?

passkey.requiresSecureContext: Passkey sign-in requires a secure connection (HTTPS)

errors.failed: Passkey sign-in failed. Please try again or use your password.
errors.passwordChangeRequired: This account must change its password. Sign in with your password to change it, then you can use your passkey again.

return.title: Single sign-on
return.verifyingDescription: Confirming your identity with the server
return.failedDescription: Single sign-on could not finish. Nothing was changed on your account.
return.reauthWithPasskey: Sign in again with your passkey
return.backToLogin: Sign in with a password instead
return.footer: Password sign-in stays available if single sign-on fails

errors.missingCode: The sign-in link is incomplete or was already used. Start again from the sign-in page.
errors.invalidState: The sign-in request could not be verified. Start again from this browser.
errors.providerDenied: The identity provider declined the sign-in.
errors.transactionExpired: The sign-in session expired or was started in another browser. Start again from this browser.
errors.notLinked: This identity is not linked to any account. Sign in with your password, then link SSO from your profile.
errors.notAuthorized: This identity has no access to this workspace. Ask your administrator to grant you a role in your identity provider.
errors.accountExists: An account with this name already exists. Sign in with your account, then link SSO from your profile.
errors.accountUnavailable: The linked account is suspended or unavailable. Contact your workspace administrator.
errors.disabled: Single sign-on is not enabled on this server.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.providerUnavailable: The identity provider is unavailable right now. Try again later or sign in with a password.
errors.sessionFailed: Your identity was confirmed, but the session could not be opened. Try again.
errors.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errors.configChanged: The single sign-on settings changed while you were signing in. Start again.
errors.loginNotInitiated: This sign-in did not start from this app. Start again from the sign-in page.
errors.ssoUnavailable: Single sign-on is unavailable right now. Sign in with your password, or contact the installation owner.
errors.passwordChangeRequired: You must change your password first. Sign in with your password to change it.
errors.ownerLocalOnly: Owner accounts sign in with their password or passkey here. To use single sign-on, turn it on in Settings → Single sign-on after signing in.
errors.ownerKeyRequired: Owner sign-in through single sign-on needs your passkey; a password alone is not enough. Sign in again with your key, or use your password here instead.
errors.ownerReauthRequired: Owner sign-in through single sign-on needs a fresh sign-in at your identity provider. Sign in again with your passkey.

sso.unavailableNotice: Single sign-on is temporarily unavailable. Contact the installation owner, or sign in with your password if you have one.
sso.autoSignInStopped: Automatic sign-in stopped after repeated attempts. Sign in below.

ownerStepUp.title: Confirm with your passkey
ownerStepUp.description: This action needs a fresh passkey touch. It stays valid for about an hour in this browser.
ownerStepUp.failed: Passkey confirmation could not start. Try again.
ownerStepUp.returnFailed: Passkey confirmation did not complete. Nothing was changed.

loginLocked: Sign-in is temporarily locked after repeated failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
loggedOutEverywhere: You have been signed out on all devices.
